predictions.articleTitle: Airbus UK vs Colwyn Bay Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Peers Break the Seagulls' Defence?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Colwyn Bay's tighter 1.12 goals-conceded structure and six-match unbeaten run support Draw / Away Win alongside Over 2.5 and BTTS: Yes against Airbus UK's high-scoring yet porous 2.12/1.50 profile.
possibilityAssessment: Draw / Away Win covering Colwyn Bay's defensive edge and Airbus's home scoring power (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Over 2.5 Goals & BTTS: Yes supported by lambda_total 3.24 and 80.2% single-side scoring expectancy (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
High-scoring 2:2 stalemate branch if George Peers stretches Colwyn Bay's backline twice (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: In-form Peers faces Colwyn Bay's resilient top-four defensive unit.

spf.comment: Covers a 1:2 Colwyn Bay win driven by their 1.12 goals-conceded edge and a 2:2 draw branch if Airbus's 2.12 goals-per-game attack breaches them twice, where a single call ignores symmetric 38.4% vs 38.4% Poisson win weights.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 3.24 combined lambda total (62.8% Over 2.5) and Airbus UK averaging 3.62 total goals per league match.

btts.comment: Both sides hold an 80.2% Poisson scoring probability (64.3% BTTS Yes), with Airbus conceding twice in four straight games despite Peers's 17 league goals.

score.comment: 1:2 captures Colwyn Bay's defensive edge holding Airbus to one goal, while 2:2 covers the open four-goal stalemate if both attacks convert.

goals.comment: 3 goals (22.2%) and 4 goals (18.0%) lead the Over 2.5 Poisson density bands and align with 1:2 and 2:2.

bqc.comment: A level first half against Colwyn Bay's compact shape opens after the break toward either a 1:2 away win (Draw-Loss) or a 2:2 draw (Draw-Draw).
